patch.sql:
select distinct
    c_custkey as customer_key,
    c_name as customer_name,
    c_address as address,
    c_phone as phone,
    c_nationkey as nation_key,
    c_mktsegment as market_segment,
    c_acctbal as account_balance
from {{ source('raw', 'customer') }}
patch.explanation: The unique_stg_customers_customer_key test failed with 225 duplicate customer_key values. raw.customer has 1725 rows but only 1500 distinct c_custkey, indicating duplicate primary keys. Inspection shows duplicate rows (e.g., c_custkey=6) are identical across all columns, matching the policy for identical duplicate deliveries. Deduplicating in the staging model with SELECT DISTINCT resolves the uniqueness violation without losing data.
